decisions.reason: The consumer superfood drink mix is farthest from the firm's core chemical and engineering knowledge, limiting absorptive capacity to interpret results and improve it.
It directly extends the firm's waste-to-energy expertise, so the firm can readily assimilate feedback and refine the modular extensions.
As a flagship waste-oil-to-energy plant closely tied to existing capabilities, strong absorptive capacity supports learning and improvement.
